This site is maintained by the Jornada Information Management (IM) team to support researchers and data managers working with data from the [Jornada Basin LTER (JRN)](https://lter.jornada.nmsu.edu) and [Jornada Experimental Range (JER)](https://jornada.nmsu.edu) programs.

::: {.callout-caution collapse="false"}
## This site is a work in progress!
Report problems and suggest additions in the [issue tracker](https://github.com/jornada-im/jornada-im.github.io/issues).

:::
